description: This file implements serialization and deserialization of BackoffEntry objects, including handling of failure counts, backoff durations, and release times, with versioning support.

methods.name: SerializeToList
methods.description: Serializes a BackoffEntry object into a list of values, including version, failure count, backoff duration, and release time.

methods.name: DeserializeFromList
methods.description: Deserializes a list of values into a BackoffEntry object, reconstructing its state based on stored failure count, backoff duration, and release time, with version handling.
